title: Jenkins & Sonar
summary: Executed tests and quality evidence attached to the actual candidate.

sections.label: Proposed automation
items: Fetch the failed stage and first actionable failure.
Distinguish code, fixture, environment, permission, and infrastructure failures.
Run focused checks during development; apply established broader gates at milestones.
Attach run identity, commit, report links, quality-gate result, and exclusions.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Pipeline success is evidence of the checks that ran, not proof of every requirement. A missing or skipped report remains visible.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
